maya: Quick heads up — Trial cohort A (5 accounts) is stalling during Step 2 of the onboarding wizard (API key + model pick). Drop in completion from ~80% -> 30% in the last 48h. Thinking a rapid 'first-touch retention' play: offer 20-min live setup + one-page checklist + a quick rollback helper. Who can own outreach tomorrow? :eyes:

 tom: i can take 3 of the accounts (stripepay, quickshop, velox). pls schedule me for 11:30 PT and i'll do the 20-min walk. :+1:

 andre: i'll draft the 20-min script and the short checklist. will post a template here in ~30m.

 whitney: can cs-bot run the health export for those 5 accounts and surface top 3 friction logs? also need recent prompt samples and last successful step timestamp.

 cs-bot: export complete. csv: https://redwood.internal/exports/onboard-friction-1725.csv (access: cs-team). top errors: model load timeout x3, creds mismatch x1, UI validation block x1.

 maya: perfect — andre drop the script, whitney add calendar invites, tom pls ping me when scheduled. aim: reduce downgrade risk and capture actionable product feedback. :memo:

 andre: script v1 below:
```
- 0-2m: intro + confirm account owner & goals
- 2-6m: ensure API key installed, confirm endpoint logs show token handshake
- 6-12m: model selection walkthrough (explain tradeoffs: latency vs quality)
- 12-16m: run a test prompt together, save as preset
- 16-18m: if model fails to load use quick rollback: `rw model set --id=compat-small`
- 18-20m: capture 1-sentence friction and 1 suggested fix, schedule follow-up if needed
```

 whitney: invites sent for 11:30 PT to three accounts, two pending. attached call agenda + checklist link: https://redwood.internal/docs/first-touch-checklist.

 tom: calls accepted by 2/3 accounts so far. one account asked for sample config JSON — sending now. will report blockers after calls.

 maya: thanks team — action items: tom (execute outreach), andre (finalize script + checklist), whitney (capture logs + invites). recon in 48h. if we see >40% activation uplift -> formalize into CS playbook and add an outbound cadence.

 andre: noted. will add a single-question NPS "Was the setup clear?" at the end of the call and a required field for "primary blocker".

 cs-bot: reminder set: recon check in 1725000045 (48h) and will ping @channel for results. :robot_face:
